source.author: cic
source.text: Sophocles ad summam senectutem tragoedias fecit; quod propter studium cum rem neglegere familiarem videretur, filiis in iudicium vocatus est, ut, quem ad modum nostro more male rem gerentibus patribus bonis interdici solet, sic ilium quasi desipientem a re familiari removerent iudices.
source.text_original: Sophocles ad summam senectutem tragoedias fecit; quod propter studium cum rem neglegere familiarem videretur, filiis in iudicium vocatus est, ut, quem ad modum nostro more male rem gerentibus patribus bonis interdici solet, sic ilium quasi desipientem a re familiari removerent iudices.
source.text_english: Sophocles composed tragedies up to extreme old age; and because, owing to this devotion, he seemed to neglect his household affairs, he was summoned to court by his sons, so that, just as in our custom fathers who mismanage their property are usually debarred from it, the judges might likewise remove him from his estate as though he were out of his senses.

reuse.author: hier
reuse.text: Sophocles, cum propter nimiam senectutem et rei familiaris neglegentiam a filiis accusaretur amentiae, Oedipi fabulam, quam nuper scripserat.
reuse.text_original: Sophocles, cum propter nimiam senectutem et rei familiaris neglegentiam a filiis accusaretur amentiae, Oedipi fabulam, quam nuper scripserat.
reuse.text_english: Sophocles, when because of his excessive old age and neglect of his household affairs he was being accused by his sons of madness, the play of Oedipus, which he had recently written.
